cards.title: Aging-associated extracellular signals
cards.body:
Altered inflammatory, lymphangiogenic and matrix-related inputs
Examples: VEGFC–NRP2 • ANGPT2–TEK • VCAN–CD44

cards.title:
Disease-associated microenvironmental
cues
cards.body:
Disease-specific inflammatory, stromal and growth-factor signaling
Prioritized pathways include BMP/TGF-β/activin, PDGF,
VEGF, ANGPT, Notch and WNT

cards.title: State-associated transcriptional regulators

cards.body:

SCENIC supports disease-specific transcriptional regulation

cards.title: Aging-associated LEC state redistribution
cards.body:
State 0 ↑
State 4 cytokine-responsive / immune ↓
State 5 matrix-interactive / structural ↓

cards.title:

remodeling
cards.body:
Cardiovascular diseases do not produce one uniform
pathological LEC state
Shared remodeling + disease-specific state changes

vessels • no change in blood vessels
